description: sigterm() is copy-pasted verbatim in crates/reader/src/main.rs:590, crates/mail/src/main.rs:298, crates/smtp/src/main.rs:307, crates/imap/src/main.rs:195, and crates/transit/src/main.rs:1536. All five are identical: install a SIGTERM handler via tokio::signal::unix and await it. Any change to SIGTERM handling requires edits in 5 places. Extract to pub async fn wait_for_sigterm() in stoa_core (e.g. stoa_core::signals) and replace all 5 call sites.
title: Extract sigterm() to stoa_core to eliminate 5-way duplication
